in_arabic.name: رمز
in_arabic.meaning: رمز يعني علامة أو إشارة خفية ذات معنى خاص
in_arabic.long_meaning: رمز هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني العلامة أو الإشارة الخفية التي تحمل معنى خاصًا، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة يونس: ﴿وَمَا كُنتُ لَهُم بِشَهِيدٍ وَمَا كُنتُ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ ﴾، الآية ١٩. و يرمز الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية إلى السرية و الاختفاء و الحكمة

in_urdu.name: رمز
in_urdu.long_meaning: رمز ایک مذکر نام ہے جس کی اصل عربی ہے۔ اس کا مطلب علامت یا پوشیدہ معنیを持つ ہے۔ یہ لفظ قرآن مجید میں یونس سورہ میں ذکر ہوا ہے: ﴿وَمَا كُنتُ لَهُم بِشَهِيدٍ وَمَا كُنتُ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ ﴾، آیت ١٩. اسلامی ثقافت میں یہ نام راز و نیاز اور پوشیدگی کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: रम्ज़
in_hindi.long_meaning: रम्ज़ एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। इसका अर्थ होता है चिह्न या गुप्त अर्थ। यह शब्द कुरआन में सूरए यौनुस में पाया जाता है: ﴿وَمَا كُنتُ لَهُم بِشَهِيدٍ وَمَا كُنتُ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ ﴾، आयत १९. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम रहस्य और गहराई का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: رمز
in_pashto.long_meaning: رمز د مذکر نوم دی چی اصلي يی عربي دی. دا معنی نښه یا پټ معنی لری. دا کلمه د قران کریم د یونس سورې په ۱۹ آیت کې راغلی دی: ﴿وَمَا كُنتُ لَهُم بِشَهِيدٍ وَمَا كُنتُ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ ﴾. په افغان او پښتون کلتور کې دا نوم د پټو او نښو په معنا دی

in_english.name: Ramz
in_english.meaning: Symbol or hidden meaning, sign or code
in_english.long_meaning: Ramz is a masculine name of Arabic origin, meaning a symbol, sign, or hidden meaning. The term is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Yunus, verse 19: ﴿وَمَا كُنتُ لَهُم بِشَهِيدٍ وَمَا كُنتُ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ ﴾. In Islamic tradition, the name Ramz signifies secrecy, depth, and coded messages. It is associated with wisdom, mystery, and spiritual insight, reflecting a profound and thoughtful personality

data.cultural_impact: The month of Ramadan, during which Muslims fast from dawn to sunset, holds immense cultural significance around the world. It is a time for community, reflection, and spiritual growth. Families and friends come together to share meals and connect, while mosques and Islamic centers host daily tarawih prayers. Cultural traditions like sharing stories, giving to charity, and decorating homes with lights help to create a communal atmosphere.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Ramz" is derived from the Arabic word for fasting, and it carries a deep spiritual significance for Muslims. Fasting during Ramadan is one of the Five Pillars of Islam, and it serves as a reminder of the suffering that Prophet Muhammad and his community endured during their time. Fasting not only means abstaining from food and drink but also from negative thoughts, actions, and speech. Through fasting, Muslims seek to cleanse their souls, develop self-discipline and self-control, and deepen their connection with God.

historical_references.reference: Ramadan is the ninth month of the Islamic calendar, which is a lunar calendar. It is the month in which Muslims believe the Quran was first revealed to Muhammad by the archangel Gabriel.
historical_references.context: The Islamic lunar calendar is based on the cycles of the moon, and each month begins when the new crescent moon is sighted. Ramadan is considered the holiest month in the Islamic calendar, and it is observed by Muslims around the world by fasting from dawn until sunset.

historical_references.reference: During the Prophet Muhammad's lifetime, the Islamic community in Medina was under military threat from various tribes. Ramadan was a time of intense spiritual focus, and the Prophet Muhammad would lead his community in nightly prayers and recitation of the Quran.
historical_references.context: The month of Ramadan was not only a time for spiritual reflection and devotion, but also a time for unity and community building among the early Muslim community. The Prophet Muhammad would lead his followers in nightly Taraweeh prayers, which would later become a central part of Ramadan observance.

modern_usage.modern_context: The Islamic month of Ramadan is a time for spiritual reflection, community building, and physical wellness. Many Muslims around the world participate in intermittent fasting during this month, abstaining from food and drink from dawn until sunset. This practice is often accompanied by increased prayer, charitable giving, and reflection. Platforms like Instagram, Tiktok, and Reddit have become popular spaces for Muslims to share their experiences and connect with others during Ramadan. Hashtags like #Ramadan2021, #RamadanKareem, and #RamadanChallenges are used to document and discuss various aspects of this holy month. The use of technology to facilitate spiritual growth and community building during Ramadan is a modern trend that reflects the evolving ways in which Muslims practice their faith.
